name: docedit
description: Oakqueill PDF Editor for macOS: headless core, CLI, the Electron desktop app and the browser extension.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @docedit/core && npm run build -w @docedit/cli && npm run build -w @docedit/desktop && npm run build -w @docedit/browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @docedit/core && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/browser/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.security:probe: npm run build -w @docedit/core && npm run build -w @docedit/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/security-probe.mjs
